name: Jepeta Risk Guard
purpose: Machine-readable pre-trade ERC-20 risk screening for Base tokens.

tokenAddress.description: ERC-20 token contract address on Base chain 8453

riskScore.description: Heuristic risk score. Higher means more observed risk. It is not a probability.

riskLevel.description: Risk band derived from the heuristic score.

liquidityRisk.description: Risk band for the largest matching Base pool liquidity.

dataSources.name: GoPlus Security
dataSources.purpose: Token security controls and honeypot signal

dataSources.name: DEX Screener
dataSources.purpose: Matching Base pool liquidity and recent trading activity

failureSemantics.unsupportedOrInsufficientData: No reassuring verdict is issued. The provider does not quote unsupported tokens.
failureSemantics.sourceOutage: The provider retries a bounded number of times and does not fabricate missing values.
failureSemantics.incompleteData: Unknown fields are surfaced explicitly and cannot produce a reassuring LOW classification.

engine.methodology: Heuristic screening, not a smart-contract audit, safety guarantee, or investment recommendation.

resources.name: free_base_token_risk_preview
resources.description: Free pre-trade Base ERC-20 risk preview for agents. Supply one exact token contract address before a swap or buy.

tokenAddress.description: Exact Base ERC-20 token contract address to scan

resources.name: sample_full_report
resources.description: Real paid-deliverable shape captured from a live Jepeta scan; values are a dated sample and can change.

semantics.PASS: No configured BLOCK or WARN condition was observed in the available data. PASS is not a safety guarantee.
semantics.WARN: One or more material risk or source-quality conditions require review before execution.
semantics.BLOCK: A configured hard blocker such as a GoPlus honeypot signal was observed.

rawMetrics.top10_holder_concentration_percent: Sum of valid percentages in the up-to-10 holder records returned by GoPlus.
rawMetrics.lp_locked_percent_observed: Sum of locked percentages among the up-to-10 LP-holder records returned by GoPlus. This is observed sample coverage, not a proof that all liquidity is locked.
rawMetrics.buy_tax_percent: GoPlus buy tax converted to percent; null when unavailable.
rawMetrics.sell_tax_percent: GoPlus sell tax converted to percent; null when unavailable.
rawMetrics.liquidity_usd: Liquidity of the largest exact matching Base pair returned by DEX Screener; null when unavailable.

booleanGuarantees.is_honeypot: Always boolean in a successful v4 response; if GoPlus cannot determine it, the endpoint returns 422 instead of false.
booleanGuarantees.is_mintable: Always boolean in a successful v4 response; if GoPlus cannot determine it, the endpoint returns 422 instead of false.

rateLimit.clientWindow: 30 requests / 60 seconds per hashed client address

cache.purpose: Protect upstream GoPlus and DEX Screener quotas and reduce repeated-token latency.

productLadder.name: Full Report
productLadder.delivery: Virtuals ACP v2 / Token Risk Scan

productLadder.name: Batch / API
productLadder.activationGate: Enable only after repeated multi-token paid demand and measured unit economics.

productLadder.name: Monitoring / Watchlist
productLadder.activationGate: Enable after recurring risk-monitoring demand is observed.

productLadder.name: Agent Subscription
productLadder.activationGate: Enable after repeat buyers justify a recurring access package.
